Item 1. Business

Acme designs rocket powered roller skates and anvils for coyotes. Our products are sold through retail partners and our own online store. We compete with Wile Industries and Roadrunner Supply on price, product quality and delivery speed. Demand for anvils is seasonal and peaks in the desert summer. Our strategy is to expand into portable holes and giant magnets over the next two years.

Item 1A. Risk Factors

Our business depends on a small number of suppliers of rocket engines, and any supply chain disruption could delay shipments. Export controls on rocket engines could restrict our sales in certain countries. A single customer accounts for a significant share of revenue, so losing that customer would hurt results. For a discussion of results, see Item 7 of this report.

Item 7. Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations

Revenue grew because anvil demand was strong while roller skate sales declined. Gross margin improved due to lower steel costs. We expect higher marketing spend next year.
